svg.title: Pages contain per-generator segments
svg.desc: A RECORD_BLOCK has uncompressed headers and independently compressed pages. Page 0 contains segments for generators 18 and 19. Page 1 contains segments for generators 18 and 20. Generator 18 spans both pages.
svg.text: Uncompressed block, segment, and page headers
Each page decompresses independently. A generator can span pages.
